2727855.sourceDescription: Bring the festive sparkle to life with this 6ft pre-lit Christmas tree. whv3a2mm.baseName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 115 cm Wide - White - 180 cm
whv3a2mm.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree 115 cm Wide - White - 180 cm
whv3a2mm.sourceDescription: This artificial Christmas tree brings modern flair and festivity to any living room or outdoor space. With a cone-shaped structure and vibrant green hue, it offers the classic beauty of a real tree without the mess. Its rough texture mimics the natural feel, enhancing the seasonal atmosphere wherever it's placed. The tree effortlessly integrates into a modern home, offering a serene backdrop for gatherings and quiet evenings alike. Durable Plastic Construction Crafted from high-quality plastic, the tree structure ensures it stands firm and resists tipping over. The material is selected not only for its resilience but also for the way it mimics natural greenery, bringing an authentic touch to your holiday decorating. Maintenance is straightforward; simply avoid prolonged exposure to sunlight to keep it looking vibrant. Integrated String Lights The tree comes adorned with decorative string lights, featuring LED bulbs that offer a warm white glow. These lights are energy-efficient, eliminating the need for replacing bulbs frequently. Each strand is strategically placed to evenly illuminate the tree, enhancing your holiday joy without the hassle of tangled wires. Practical USB Power Source Designed with modern convenience in mind, the tree's LED lights are powered by a USB connection. This feature allows you to easily position the tree wherever desired, without worrying about proximity to traditional power outlets. Its universal compatibility makes it an ideal choice for integrating into different room setups. Versatile Seasonal Décor Suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments, it's perfect for enhancing various spaces during the holiday season. Its modern style complements contemporary decors, effortlessly adding a festive cheer to both private and public spaces, such as living rooms, offices, or sheltered patios. Simple Assembly Following the manufacturer's instructions ensures a hassle-free setup with minimal tools required -scissors suffice for the task. Once assembled, it commands attention with its sleek design, crafting a quintessential Christmas focal point in any setting. Product Specifications Colour: White PVC and steel and plastic Tree height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 115 cm Durable With Thick Branches Lifelike Tips Number of PVC tips: 930 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Warm white Number of LEDs: 300 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 V Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

qh8b93j6.baseName: Neo Rotating Christmas Tree Stand 50cm Base Integrated Power Outlet
qh8b93j6.variantName: Neo Rotating Christmas Tree Stand 50cm Base Integrated Power Outlet
qh8b93j6.sourceDescription: Showcase your festive decorations from every angle with the Neo Rotating Christmas Tree Stand, suitable for trees up to 2.1m tall. Featuring a 50cm diameter star-shaped base, this electric Christmas tree stand offers a choice of lighting only or lighting with rotation, controlled by a simple three-position switch. Centre pole holders are available in 19mm, 22mm and 32mm sizes to accommodate different tree poles, while the integrated power outlet lets you connect your Christmas tree lights for an eye-catching festive display. SUITABLE FOR TREES UP TO 2.1M: Display your Christmas tree on a 50cm diameter, five-point star-shaped base. ROTATING CHRISTMAS TREE STAND: Show off your baubles, lights and decorations from every angle with powered rotation. THREE-POSITION SWITCH: Switch up for lights on with rotation off, select the middle position to turn both off, or switch down for lights and rotation on. CHOICE OF POLE HOLDERS: Centre pole holders are available in 19mm, 22mm and 32mm diameters. Select the correct size for your tree. INTEGRATED LIGHTING OUTLET: Connect your Christmas tree lights using the built-in outlet. Supplied with a black power cable and UK three-pin plug. For indoor domestic use only. This product is not a toy. Keep children and pets away from the rotating mechanism, electrical connections and power cable. Suitable for artificial christmas trees up to 2.1m tall, provided the tree is compatible with the stand. Ensure the stand is positioned on a flat, stable and level surface before use. Select the correct pole holder size (19mm, 22mm or 32mm) and ensure the tree is securely fitted before switching on. Do not exceed the manufacturer's specified weight or electrical load limits. Keep hands, clothing, decorations and other objects clear of moving parts during rotation. Only connect compatible christmas tree lights to the integrated power outlet. Do not overload the socket or use damaged electrical cables. Keep away from water, moisture and heat sources. Do not operate if the stand, plug, cable or rotating mechanism is damaged. Always switch off and unplug before assembling, adjusting, cleaning or moving the tree. Do not leave the product operating unattended. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use. Retain all instructions for future reference. Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW
